# Contract Changelog

## 2.0.0 — 2026-08-23

- Define navigation, taxonomy, static-page, redirect, and shared content-block records.
- Require stable heading IDs and `/article/<slug>` article canonicals.
- Remove producer-supplied search indexes and fix the media manifest path.
- Define deterministic per-file and RFC 8785 bundle checksums.
- Add a complete Site A bundle fixture and semantic failure fixtures.

## 1.0.0 — 2026-08-23

- Freeze the first ContentOps ↔ Public Sites contract.
- Define immutable release bundles and article public projections.
- Define site identity, theme/skin configuration, and site isolation.
- Define media integrity and immutable media references.
- Define publish/update/unpublish/delete/reconcile semantics.
- Define semantic versioning, error classes, compatibility, rollback, and validation fixtures.
- Declare precedence over duplicated boundary descriptions in the existing 01/02/03 documentation sets.
